Runway stands at {{fact:6c5e14bf-038d-451f-98a8-c96f8f96179b}} months, so on current burn the company has limited time to fund itself before needing new capital. The falling runway and cash covenant headroom signals show this position has worsened steadily since August, and with revenue holding above plan, the pressure appears to come from spending rather than sales.

Headroom on the minimum runway covenant fell from {{fact:d7362521-2c9c-44a5-a24a-e3f36a1e6809}} in August to {{fact:8775773d-469c-4c44-b02b-bade3d4452b3}} in October, with runway at {{fact:c746b4ed-8d18-4439-8674-1ff42a1f6bee}} months against a floor of {{fact:630c254d-1471-4fb0-8e22-60bc5dc8ed50}}. This is the covenant view of the high-severity runway signal; if the monthly decline continues, the cushion would erode quickly.

Unrestricted cash of {{fact:e53ca936-67bd-4911-accb-2b7340013477}} remains above the {{fact:b9b02449-0279-4f33-b9bb-4cf4e737fcaa}} minimum, but headroom dropped from {{fact:47def611-aadb-4032-968d-a723a25a8da2}} in August to {{fact:22dc8874-a5ff-4b77-812d-7550cf39f087}} in October. The steady cash drawdown is the direct driver behind the shrinking runway.

Revenue is running at {{fact:8a27379c-e6c9-4471-bbc9-18c9b4bc6883}} of plan against an {{fact:826cdbf2-11da-4955-be7c-8c70b9d676c4}} floor, and headroom has been essentially flat, moving only from {{fact:a97dd6de-e2d1-40f2-bae5-d195293e31b4}} to {{fact:3e767099-3ffd-499e-a3de-6ac1fec713a9}}. This is a mitigating signal: sales are not the source of the cash and runway deterioration.
